::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Planned, from the syllabus"}
Delete this block once the lesson is drafted.

> - A key signature is a default rule applied to every matching letter until overridden.
> - An accidental is a local override that expires at the end of the bar. This is scoping, and you know scoping.
> - Write the resolver: letter plus key signature plus local accidentals in, MIDI number out.
>
> **Ends with: a small resolver you reuse in every transcription from here on.**
:::
